## Requirements

- **FR-001** (test): The editor shall save the title.
- **FR-002** (test): While the keyboard is open, the form shall keep the focused field visible.
- **FR-003** (test): When the user saves, edits, or deletes a title, the editor shall show "Saved, or not".
- **FR-004** (smoke): Where the device has a camera, the app shall offer a photo upload.
- **FR-005** (test): If the upload fails, then the app shall keep the old photo.
- **FR-006** (device): While the screen is locked, when the user taps the icon, the app shall stay locked.
- **FR-007** (test): While the network is down, if the user saves, then the app shall queue the save.
- **FR-008** (test): THE EDITOR SHALL KEEP KEYWORDS IN ANY CASE.
